text:
zoe_cs: Heads up - Helion wants to renew but asked to convert to quarterly invoices and a 9mo term. They said procurement requires the signer to use SSO for Adobe Sign. PO here: https://helion.pm/PO-2201
alex_ae: Quarterly billing ok from product standpoint? Any pricing change requests?
rachel_fin: Quarterly billing is fine but increases ops overhead. Need to confirm cash flow impact. ARR is $200k; 9mo pro rata = $150k. If billed quarterly that's 3 invoices: $50k each. Also need vendor_code and invoice entity.
ben_legal: SSO for Adobe Sign is unusual. We need to confirm if their IdP supports SAML and if our Esign integration can federate. If they insist, legal wants the Signatory identity confirmation clause added. Otherwise use standard amendment.
zoe_cs: Customer says they use Okta and can SAML-provision. They prefer quarterly to match their internal approvals. Also asked for a one-time setup discount of $2,500 to help with billing transition.
rachel_fin: One-time $2.5k credit is within delegation if we document as a line-item credit. Approve if vendor_code and Net30/ACH confirmed. Net60 no.
alex_ae: I'll ask them to confirm vendor_code and if Okta SSO can be used for signing. I'll also flag that quarterly increases the number of invoices.
docsign_bot: DocSign task created: DS-3312. Status: awaiting idp-proof and finance_approved.
ben_legal: If they can provide an Okta admin screenshot or SAML metadata file we can proceed. I'll draft a short clause: "Signatory authentication via customer IdP assertion" to append to the amendment. Keep it minimal.
zoe_cs: Action items: (1) Alex confirm IdP metadata & vendor_code (2) Rachel finalize finance_approved for $2.5k credit (3) Ben prep clause if SSO required (4) I prepare amendment and DocSign envelope once items in.
alex_ae: Pinged procurement@helion.com for vendor_code and SAML metadata. They replied with vendor code VC-7722 and attached SAML metadata xml. Forwarding now.
rachel_fin: VC-7722 received. Finance approves $2.5k one-time credit. Marking finance_approved. Net30 ACH ok.
ben_legal: Reviewed SAML metadata; OK. Drafted clause and uploaded amendment draft: https://drive.redwood/amendments/helion-9mo-qtr-draft. No other contract refs.
docsign_bot: DS-3312 updated with amendment and vendor_code. Sent to customer for SSO-validated signature. Envelope ID env_9f3b.
zoe_cs: Thanks all. I'll close loop after signature and confirm invoice entities for routing. :thumbsup:
